stories.name: Niv-Mizzet, Dracogenius
stories.intro: You reach the top of Nivix, where the great accumulator crackles under an open sky. Niv-Mizzet uncoils from his perch, wings spread over the whole laboratory. He has no patience for a mind that does not inspire him, and he means to test yours with fire.
stories.win: The Dracogenius folds his wings and concedes that you have surprised him. He yields, and his card is yours.
stories.lose: A bolt from the dragon's eye throws you down the spiral stairs of Nivix.
stories.flee: You run for the stairs as his laughter shakes the tower.

stories.name: Frostburn Weird
stories.intro: A chemister's perfect weird has slipped its tank. Half frost and half flame, it hisses steam as it walks. It flares hotter as it rushes you, burning itself thinner to hit harder.
stories.win: The weird cools to a steady glow and drifts after you. It is yours now.
stories.lose: Frost and fire hit you at once, and you collapse in the steam.
stories.flee: You slam the lab door, and the weird fogs the glass behind you.

stories.name: Goblin Electromancer
stories.intro: A goblin in a copper harness stands in a ring of humming coils. When asked how much power he needs, he says more. He points a crackling finger at you to find out.
stories.win: The electromancer powers down and offers to make your spells come cheaper. He is yours now.
stories.lose: Lightning arcs from the coils and leaves you twitching on the floor.
stories.flee: You run before the coils finish charging.

stories.name: Izzet Charm
stories.title: A charm with three settings
stories.text: An Izzet guildmage is selling charms from a cart of tangled wire. Each charm has a dial with three settings. She swears none of them explode, then pauses to reconsider.

choices.text: Buy a charm at her price

outcome.text: She wraps the charm in copper foil and wishes you luck.

choices.text: Turn the dial and see what it does

outcome.text: You twist the dial while she looks away.

huge_success.text: The charm hums and shows you two secrets, and the guildmage lets you keep it.

success.text: A spark jumps harmlessly, and the guildmage, delighted, gives you the charm.

failure.text: The charm zaps your hand, and she snatches it back.

huge_failure.text: The cart goes up in a shower of sparks, and you pay for the damage.

outcome.text: You leave her rewiring the cart.

stories.name: Izzet Guildgate
stories.text: A gate of copper and blue glass hums at the edge of an Izzet district, sparking at whoever passes. You can claim it for a tile you have walked.

stories.name: Chemister's Trick
stories.title: A potion of bad ideas
stories.text: An Izzet chemister uncorks a vial under a guard's nose. The guard's arms go weak, and he charges at the nearest wall. The chemister writes something down.

outcome.text: She gives it to you in exchange for your observations.
You lean in.

success.text: You keep your head, and she gives you the vial for science.

outcome.text: You leave the guard picking himself up.

stories.name: Counterflux
stories.title: Spells into vapour
stories.text: In an Izzet duelling hall, a mage turns every spell aimed at her into harmless steam. Her rivals cannot touch her. She is looking for a challenger.

outcome.text: You cast your best spell.

huge_success.text: You find a gap in her ward, and she teaches you the counter herself.

success.text: She counters you, then shows you how she did it.

failure.text: Your spell comes back at you as scalding steam.

outcome.text: You study her for an hour and leave with the trick.
You leave the steam behind.

stories.name: Epic Experiment
stories.title: The great experiment
stories.text: A chemister has filled a vault with spells and wants to cast them all at once. The vault hums. She is looking for someone to throw the switch.

outcome.text: You step up to the bench.

huge_success.text: Every spell goes off perfectly, and she names the experiment after you.

success.text: Most of the spells go off, and she gives you her notes.

failure.text: A spell hits you on its way out of the vault.

huge_failure.text: The vault explodes and you are billed for it.

choices.text: Buy a copy of her plan

outcome.text: The chemister sells it to you, still warm.
You leave the humming vault behind.

stories.name: Essence Backlash
stories.title: Interference punished
stories.text: An Izzet blastseeker is turning a rival's summoned beast back into raw mana. The mana snaps back into the summoner's face. The other guilds will learn not to interfere, she says.

choices.text: Help her with the next one

outcome.text: She lets you keep the backlash spell.
A wisp of mana slides past you.

huge_success.text: You catch it whole, and it settles into a card.

success.text: You catch enough to keep the spell.

outcome.text: You leave the summoner nursing his nose.

stories.name: Firemind's Foresight
stories.title: A list of answers
stories.text: A chemister has written three answers on a board before anyone has asked the questions. She is sure they will be needed. She wants to test her foresight on you.

outcome.text: You step up to the bench.

huge_success.text: Her answer is perfect, and she gives you the list.

success.text: Her answer is close enough, and she lets you keep the board.

failure.text: Her answer sets your hair alight.

huge_failure.text: Her answer sets the lab alight.

outcome.text: The chemister sells it to you, still warm.
You leave her waiting for the next question.

stories.name: Hypersonic Dragon
stories.intro: A young dragon tears across the sky faster than its own sound, and windows break behind it. Even this primitive specimen is impressive, Niv-Mizzet once said. It turns and comes back for you.
stories.win: The dragon lands in a crack of thunder and agrees to fly with you. It is yours now.
stories.lose: Its passing knocks you flat and leaves your ears ringing.
stories.flee: You throw yourself into a doorway as it passes.

stories.name: Izzet Staticaster
stories.intro: A staticaster stands on a roof with a coil of copper on her back. She zaps anything that moves, and anything else that looks like it. She has noticed you.
stories.win: She lowers her coil and agrees to cover you. She is yours now.
stories.lose: A bolt of static throws you off your feet.
stories.flee: You hold very still until she looks away, then run.

stories.name: Mercurial Chemister
stories.intro: A chemister stares at a bubbling flask, and the flask stares back. What some call distracted, he says, is fathoming the unfathomable. He throws the flask at you.
stories.win: He fathoms that you are useful and joins you. He is yours now.
stories.lose: The flask bursts into flame across your boots.

stories.name: Nivix Guildmage
stories.intro: A guildmage of Nivix stands in a ring of sparks, testing a spell that copies spells. The only action worth taking, he says, has an unknown outcome. He takes one at you.
stories.win: He grins and agrees to see what happens with you. He is yours now.
stories.lose: His copied spell hits you twice.
stories.flee: You leave him to his copies.

stories.name: Teleportal
stories.title: A door that is not there
stories.text: A chemister has painted a door on a wall, and the door opens onto another street. She needs someone to walk through it and report back.

outcome.text: You step up to the bench.

huge_success.text: You step out across the district, and she gives you the formula. Something on the other side calls you back.

success.text: You come out a street away, and she lets you keep the paint. Something on the other side calls you back.

failure.text: You come out in a canal.

huge_failure.text: You come out in an Azorius holding cell, and pay to leave.

choices.text: Buy a pot of her paint

outcome.text: The chemister sells it to you, still warm.
You leave the door painted on the wall.

stories.name: Thoughtflare
stories.title: A flare of thought
stories.text: A chemister is sparking ideas into the air, and each one bursts like a firework. If this is thinking, a student says, he does not know what he was doing before. She offers you a spark.

outcome.text: You step up to the bench.

huge_success.text: Ideas pour in, and she gives you the spell that brought them. Then the spark slips loose and flees into the street.

success.text: One good idea stays, and the spell stays with it. Then the spark slips loose and flees into the street.

failure.text: The spark burns your eyebrows off.

huge_failure.text: The spark burns your notes and your purse.

outcome.text: The chemister sells it to you, still warm.
You leave the sparks to the student.

stories.name: Blistercoil Weird
stories.intro: A weird of blistered copper and steam rolls down the street, swelling bigger with every spell cast nearby. The Azorius cannot decide how to classify it. It has decided to classify you as a threat.
stories.win: The weird cools and rolls along behind you. It is yours now.
stories.lose: It swells and knocks you into a gutter.
stories.flee: You run before anyone casts a spell near it.

stories.name: Nivmagus Elemental
stories.intro: An elemental of loose sparks escapes from an Izzet lab and starts eating spells out of the air. The experimenters hesitate to stop it. They want to see what it does to you.
stories.win: The elemental hums, full, and follows you. It is yours now.
stories.lose: It eats your spell and then your strength.
stories.flee: You run, and the experimenters take notes.

stories.name: Izzet Keyrune
stories.title: A key that sparks
stories.text: In the window of an Izzet shop sits a keyrune carved with a spark and a wave. It hums when you look at it. The shopkeeper says it can open more than doors.

outcome.text: The shopkeeper wraps it in copper foil.
The keyrune buzzes in your palm.

huge_success.text: It springs into a small elemental and back, and the shopkeeper says it chose you.

success.text: It sparks happily, and the shopkeeper lets you have it.

failure.text: It shocks you, and the shopkeeper takes it back.

huge_failure.text: It shocks the shop, and you pay for the damage.

outcome.text: You leave the keyrune humming.

stories.name: Steam Vents
stories.text: Hot steam pours from an old Izzet works, crafted with genius and running on madness. You can claim it for a tile you have walked.
